UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd clusterio && J=\"node/bin/node node_modules/@clusterio/controller/dist/node/controller.js --log-level=warn\" && $J config set controller.http_port {{$HttpPort}} && $J config set controller.bind_address \"{{$ApplicationIPBinding}}\" && $J config set controller.name \"{{ClusterName}}\" && $J config set controller.public_url \"{{PublicURL}}\" && for f in allow_remote_updates allow_plugin_updates allow_plugin_install; do $J config set controller.$f {{AllowRemoteUpdates}} || exit 1; done"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location clusterio; $J = 'node_modules/@clusterio/controller/dist/node/controller.js'; function S($k, $v) { & node\node.exe $J --log-level=warn config set $k $v; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 } }; S 'controller.http_port' '{{$HttpPort}}'; S 'controller.bind_address' '{{$ApplicationIPBinding}}'; S 'controller.name' '{{ClusterName}}'; S 'controller.public_url' '{{PublicURL}}'; foreach ($f in 'allow_remote_updates','allow_plugin_updates','allow_plugin_install') { S ('controller.' + $f) '{{AllowRemoteUpdates}}' }"
